description:
Eagle Seven is a privately held, globally positioned algorithmic trading firm. Headquartered in Chicago, Eagle Seven combines the latest technology with a unique group of professional traders and innovative developers to achieve the highest results. Recognizing that market opportunity knows no boundaries, Eagle Seven executes trading strategies across a diverse range of asset classes at the leading exchanges around the world.

We are committed to exploring new markets and emerging technologies which enable us to flourish with a commitment to outstanding principles and individuals who embody them. Our diverse team work together to leverage the latest technological innovations and ensure optimal trade execution, comprehensive risk management, and high-speed connectivity.

Please check our open positions below. If you don’t see a position that interests you, please email your résumé to resumes@eagleseven.com. We are always interested in meeting dynamic and passionate entry level algorithmic and discretionary traders as well as experienced traders and developers.

Eagle Seven is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
Eagle Seven is seeking an experienced Algorithmic Trader to trade futures contract listed on Eurex, ICE, and CME. The trader, along with the Head of the Desk, will be responsible for managing all aspects of trading desk operations. The right candidate will have a passion for capital markets, work well in a collaborative team setting, and be a motivated self-starter.

Primary Responsibilities include:

  • Operating grey and black box algorithmic trading strategies in accordance with the trading desk’s objectives
  • Monitoring of trading activity and positions consistently throughout the shift
  • Performing research and post trade analysis using the firm’s research tools on a variety of algorithmic trading strategies to improve profitability of existing models
  • Applying expertise in market microstructure, historical tick data, and quantitative modeling to conduct research and develop new sources of alpha
  • Working closely with strategy developers to collaborate, propose, and test certain strategy specific code changes related to execution, pricing, and risk management
  • Communicating with risk managers and internal technology groups regarding production issues
  • Building and maintaining quantitative modeling tools and analytics
  • Working with back office to solve for trade breaks, position & activity reconciliation exceptions

Requirements

Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, mathematics, engineering, business/finance, or related field
  • 4-6 years of experience trading financial products (e.g options, futures)
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and math skills
  • Experience with Python required
  • Ability to work independently and successfully manage multiple tasks in a complex and fast-paced environment
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrated strong work ethic and team player focused on contributing to the success of the trading desk

Benefits

Eagle Seven offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to all full-time employees.

  • Medical PPO and HMO coverage through BlueCross BlueShield
  • Health Savings Account (with enrollment into a High Deductible Health Plan)
  • Dental coverage through Guardian
  • Vision coverage through VSP
  • 401k Retirement Savings Plan with Employer Match
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Company Paid Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Pre-tax Transit Benefits
  • Complimentary Lunch and Beverages

jobs.description:
Eagle Seven is seeking a Senior Software Developer to design and build systems that support firmwide positions, PnL, and risk services. These systems transform high-volume trading and market data into accurate, timely, and actionable information.

The ideal candidate enjoys building performance-sensitive distributed systems and has a strong commitment to reliability and sound software design. In this role, you will collaborate closely with traders, strategy developers, and fellow engineers to develop infrastructure that is central to the firm’s daily operations.

 

Primary Responsibilities include:

  • Designing and building real-time position, PnL and risk services with strict latency requirements
  • Developing high performance, highly available distributed systems capable of scaling to millions of events per second
  • Architecting and implementing reliable, fault-tolerant messaging systems and data pipelines
  • Optimizing and tuning distributed systems for performance, scalability, and resiliency
  • Partnering with trading and execution teams to support evolving business needs

Requirements

Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field
  • 5+ years of experience developing high-performance distributed systems
  • Strong proficiency in modern C++(C++11/14/17) including multithreading, lock-free programming, and memory model expertise
  • Experience working with high message-rate or high-bandwidth systems
  • Proven ability to design fault-tolerant, highly available systems
  • Strong experience with relational database design and SQL (Postgress preferred)
  • Solid understanding of Linux/Unix systems, networking fundamentals, and protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, and sockets)
  • Experience with debugging and observability tools such as GDB, Wireshark and tcpdump
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively  across trading, research, and engineering teams

Benefits

Eagle Seven offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to all full-time employees.

  • Medical PPO and HMO coverage through BlueCross BlueShield
  • Health Savings Account (with enrollment into a High Deductible Health Plan)
  • Dental coverage through Guardian
  • Vision coverage through VSP
  • 401k Retirement Savings Plan with Employer Match
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Company Paid Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Pre-tax Transit Benefits
  • Complimentary Lunch and Beverages

The minimum base salary for this role starts at $160,000. This role is eligible for a discretionary performance bonus as part of the total compensation package, in addition to the benefits listed above. Exact compensation offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's experience, qualifications, and skill set.

jobs.description:
Eagle Seven is seeking a TechnologyOperations Engineer. Our Operations Team is at the intersection of trading, development, and systems administration and plays an integral part of our firm’s success. The team manages the deployments, scheduling, monitoring, and troubleshooting for multiple trading strategies. We are seeking an individual to help us solve complex problems and improve our processes and tools. The ideal candidate is someone with a strong sense of ownership who can anticipate challenges. Must be open to working a rotating schedule between US and Asia shifts.

 

Primary Responsibilities include:

  • Monitoring the trading system and working to identify and resolve issues
  • Identifying, diagnosing, and troubleshooting complex problems to keep trading online
  • Working with the risk team and trading desks to understand and facilitate trading requirements
  • Managing daily changes and communicating statuses to the company
  • Automating software distribution and deployments for Linux and Windows applications to speed up our application deployments
  • Building new tools to manage our system and reduce effort and errors

 

Requirements

Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
  • 1-3 years of experience supporting, administering, or developing on Linux-based environments
  • Strong proficiency with both Windows and Linux operating systems
  • Working knowledge of basic scripting experience, preferably with Python
  • Experience using distributed version control systems
  • Understanding of configuration management tools such as Salt, Puppet, or Chef
  • Exposure to infrastructure and application monitoring tools, including Zabbix, Nagios, Prometheus and Grafana
  • Experience working with JIRA or similar ticketing and workflow management systems
  • Knowledge of log aggregation, monitoring, and troubleshooting tools
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying, diagnosing, and resolving issues in a timely manner
  • Demonstrated ownership, initiative, and a continuous improvement mindset

Benefits

  • Health Savings Account (with enrollment into a High Deductible Health Plan)
  • Dental coverage through Guardian

  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Company Paid Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Pre-tax Transit Benefits
  • Complimentary Lunch and Beverages

The minimum base salary for this role starts at $75,000. This role is eligible for a discretionary performance bonus as part of the total compensation package, in addition to the benefits listed above.
